title: Pistachio Chicken Tagine Tacos
description: A twist on traditional Mexican tacos, incorporating warm Algerian flavors of tagine and the crunch of pistachios. A delicious fusion of cuisines.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, and tagine spice, and stir to combine.
Add the diced tomatoes and red onion, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in chopped pistachios and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by placing cooked chicken mixture onto a tortilla, and topping with chopped cilantro.
